Package arztis.econnector.rest

Class FhirElgaConnectionCaller

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.ihe.ElgaConnectionCaller
arztis.econnector.rest.FhirElgaConnectionCaller
public class FhirElgaConnectionCaller extends ElgaConnectionCaller
JAVA API for the ELGA reference client. This class includes all function calls that are required for
  • Reading the cards (e-card and Admin-Card - GINA)
  • User registration for ELGA and GINA
  • Patient contact confirmation with e-Card and bPK
  • Retrieving documents from ELGA and their eHealth applications such as the electronic immunization record or the virtual organizations
  • Posting and register documents in ELGA areas for different services such as the electronic immunization record or the eMedication
  • Canceling documents in ELGA areas for different services such as the electronic immunization record or the eMedication
  • Retrieving the ID for eMedication (eMed-Id)
  • Retrieving demographic patient data
  • List and cancel patient contacts
This class is built as singleton, so you have to call getInstance() to instantiate.

    • requestDocumentList

      public FhirBundle requestDocumentList(FhirDocumentReference documentReference, ConnectionData connData)
      This method retrieves the document list from ELGA. The method IHE ITI-18 or PHARM-1 is used in the background according to passed document type.
      Parameters:
      documentReference - contains all data to restrict the queried documents
      connData - Connection data of the respective user requesting the documents
      Returns:
      If documents were found, a list of DocumentEntryResponseType is returned, otherwise an Message with the detailed error message is returned.

    • retrieveDocuments

      public FhirBundle retrieveDocuments(ConnectionData connData, FhirDocumentReference documentReference)
      This method retrieves a certain document from ELGA. The method IHE ITI-43 is used in the background.
      Parameters:
      connData - Connection data of the respective user requesting the document
      documentReference - contains the unique id, repository id and the home community id of queried document
      Returns:
      If the document was found, FhirBundle with list of resources is returned, otherwise FhirBundle with response with details about error message is returned.

    • registerPatientContact

      public FhirBundle registerPatientContact(ConnectionData connData, PatientContactParameter contactParameter, String ginoEndpoint)
      This method first retrieves the card token form the inserted e-Card. Afterwards the identity assertion is requested by the SVC with the respective card token. The identity assertion is sent to all ELGA areas, which are enabled in the configuration file.
      Overrides:
      registerPatientContact in class ElgaConnectionCaller
      Parameters:
      connData - Connection data of the respective user, who would like to insert the contact confirmation
      contactParameter - contains details like the used card reader to register the contact confirmation
      ginoEndpoint - endpoint of the GINO Service, it is required if the patient contact should be registered with eCard
      Returns:
      If the contact confirmation was successfully submitted, true is returned. Otherwise false or an error message Message is returned.

    • findPrescriptions

      public FhirBundle findPrescriptions(ConnectionData connData, FhirDocumentReference documentReference, String typeCode)
      This method queries all prescriptions (open and closed) of a patient.
      Parameters:
      connData - the conn data
      documentReference - contains details for the restriction of prescription search such as social security number of the patient
      typeCode - the type code
      Returns:
      If the user was registered successfully and prescriptions were found, FhirBundle with FhirDocumentReference as resource is returned. If the query failed, a FhirBundle with information, why the request failed is returned.

      public FhirBundle provideAndRegisterDocuments(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Bundle bundle, ConnectionData connData, String oidTargetElgaArea)
      This method provides and registers a CDA document in the ELGA area. An ITI-41 transaction is executed in the background.
      Parameters:
